scope_quote: The report includes unit bid price averages for major categories of work (groups of items) and compares the current years quantities and pricing to the data from four years earlier. The report also includes data for each individual bid item including: the total quantity bid; the total low bid cost; the average unit low bid price (price submitted by the bidder awarded the contract); the average unit price of the lowest three bids received; and the number of times the bid item was included in a contract.
how_read: tools/parsers/parse_sddot_bid_item.py。pdftotext -bbox-layout の語の座標で 3 頁(品目群 18 x 2020/2024)と 4〜30 頁(品目 1431 x Avg Low Bid Price / Avg of 3 Lowest Bids)を読んだ。照合: bbox の品目 1431 = layout の行頭品目番号 1431(集合も一致)、全品目で Total Cost / Total Quantity と Avg Low Bid Price の差が 0.005 ドルを超えるのは 8 品目で最大 0.062%(210E3500、数量の表示桁の丸め)。列の割り当て: 7,245 セルで最近傍の列と一致(不一致 0)、ずれを引いた後の右端の距離の最大 2.02pt。0.00 の値(11 品目)は not_set。
